# S58 — CMMN source inventory

17 October 2026. WM04b is a bounded import-review increment toward full CMMN 1.1. A designer can upload one `.cmmn` or XML file from the migration workbench. The existing workspace migration job stores the source and a SHA-256-linked compatibility report. The report gives each XML element a source path and explicit blocker disposition, including extension elements and attributes, duplicate IDs and missing local references. Extension attribute values are not copied into the report. XML uses the existing bounded parser with DTD and external entity rejection.

The report deliberately marks every case construct blocked because there is no Orqix workspace case definition, public execution API or published case model. The conversion endpoint rejects CMMN jobs even if a caller supplies acknowledgements; no workflow or case is created. The UI displays the report and exports but offers no conversion button. This is an inventory, not a CMMN validator, importer, deployer or standard-conformance result. It does not yet check reference *types*, expression meaning, lifecycle semantics or engine compatibility of an arbitrary uploaded file. Flowable's internal compatibility fixture from [S57](S57-cmmn-engine-foundation.md) remains separate.

The API accepts `sourceFormat: "cmmn"`; migration V68 extends the database check constraint. The normal migration job authorization applies: workflow editors upload, readers in the same workspace view, outsiders and other workspaces cannot view. Deployment must run the migration job before the new application code receives CMMN uploads.

Evidence is retained in `evidence/cmmn-inventory-backend-final-1017.log` (19/19 focused checks, real PostgreSQL migration through V68), `evidence/cmmn-inventory-frontend-test-1017.log` (11/11), `evidence/cmmn-inventory-frontend-typecheck-final-1017.log`, `evidence/cmmn-inventory-frontend-lint-1017.log`, `evidence/cmmn-inventory-api-check-final-1017.log` and `evidence/cmmn-inventory-contracts-final-1017.log` (88/88). WM04b is closed within inventory scope. WM04 remains open for case definitions, APIs, authorization, actual CMMN conversion/execution, conformance and UI acceptance defined in [S56](S56-adaptive-cases-ui-designer-scope.md). No refreshed Docker image or full application suite is claimed.
